name: shiploop
description: Self-improving multi-agent harness that dispatches the tickets you name across every repo in your product: guarded auto-merge on green CI, and every resolved ticket writes a lesson into your git-tracked CLAUDE.md. Every ticket dispatches at a fixed floor tier and escalates once, on measured failure, rather than a tier predicted per ticket up front; deterministic fixes skip the model entirely; and the lessons file evicts old entries rather than growing without bound.
